def fact(x):
    f=1
    for i in range(2,x+1):
        f=f*i
    return f

def valeur_app(eps):
    i=0
    sa=1
    test = True
    while test:
        i=i+1
        sp=sa
        sa=sa+1/fact(i)
        if (abs(sa-sp)<=eps):
            test = False
    print("La valeur approche est: ",sa," apres ",i," iteration")

eps=float(input("Donner eps: "))
valeur_app(eps)
